name: JSON Editor
tagline: Tree or code. The file is the document. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
The last JSON you edited comes back inside this app — there is no account, and the text never leaves this device. Open it as a tree you can expand, or as code you can type. Search, format, compact, and repair from the toolbar. A line that is not valid JSON is named as such; it is not silently rewritten.

On a phone, Tree and Code are two taps at the top so the keyboard does not bury the switch. Press Invite in the bar above to let a meeting watch the same document, read-only. Nothing is uploaded on its own.

An unofficial port of JSONEditor by Jos de Jong. Same tree and code views. Their online service is not in this app.
